decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4498. Series context: trend strength 0.9926 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.368); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 25.246.
